subject: VALUE clause
notes: kb/Work PB555 - the delegation row closes: all four legs of 14.7.8 are now implemented, each MEASURED on a freshly built cobol.exe. The leg this row recorded as absent was rule 2's SECOND paragraph - 'When the IN alphabet-name phrase is specified, the collating sequence used for range evaluation is the collating sequence defined by that alphabet' with its locale and native sub-legs - and all three sub-legs measure live. (i) THE ALPHABET: `ALPHABET MYALPH IS "Z" "Y" "X" "A"` with `88 C VALUE "Z" THRU "X" IN MYALPH` and X = "Y" answers TRUE, the spec-derived answer (it answered FALSE when the phrase was discarded). (ii) THE NATIVE SUB-LEG: `ALPHABET NATALPH IS NATIVE` with `"A" THRU "C" IN NATALPH` and X = "B" answers TRUE. (iii) THE LOCALE SUB-LEG ('the range of values is determined from locale category LC_COLLATE'), measured DECISIVELY rather than by a probe every locale agrees on: `ALPHABET LOCALPH IS LOCALE` with `88 C VALUE "A" THRU "Z" IN LOCALPH` and X = U+00C4 answers INSIDE under COBOL_USER_LOCALE=en-US (CLDR root gives A-diaeresis the primary weight of A) and OUTSIDE under COBOL_USER_LOCALE=sv-SE (where it is a distinct letter collating after Z) - so LC_COLLATE is genuinely consulted and the answer cannot be the native one. Rule 1 (a numeric range is algebraic) and rule 2's LAST paragraph (literal-1 greater than literal-2 sets EC-RANGE-INVALID and the range is empty) were already measured implemented by this row's own prior adjudication and are unchanged.
